import heapq

def solve(xs):
    n = len(xs)
    small = heapq.nsmallest(n // 2 + 1, xs)
    return small[-1] if n % 2 else (small[-1] + small[-2]) / 2

def solve(xs):
    s = list(xs)
    s.sort()
    mid = len(s) // 2
    return s[mid] if len(s) % 2 == 1 else (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2

def solve(xs):
    s = sorted(xs)
    q, r = divmod(len(s), 2)
    return s[q] if r else (s[q - 1] + s[q]) / 2

def solve(xs):
    s = sorted(xs, reverse=True)
    n = len(s)
    return s[n // 2] if n % 2 else (s[n // 2] + s[n // 2 - 1]) / 2

def solve(xs):
    s = sorted(xs)
    m = len(s) // 2
    return s[m] if len(s) % 2 else sum(s[m - 1:m + 1]) / 2
